title: Accommodation near Hinkley Point C | StaysDirect
meta_description: Whole houses for Hinkley Point C crews in Cannington, Bridgwater and North Petherton from £29.50 pppn, bills included. Same-day quotes.
intro: Crews working on Hinkley Point C can stay in StaysDirect houses in Cannington, Bridgwater and North Petherton, between 5.1 and 9.6 miles from the site. Prices start from £29.50 per person per night with bills included, and we quote the same day.

sections.heading: Where the Hinkley Point C site is
sections.body_markdown:
Hinkley Point C is on the Somerset coast at Hinkley Point, near Stogursey, west of Bridgwater. It is a new nuclear power station, and the site draws specialist crews from across the UK for long periods of work.

Most crews stay inland and drive to site each day. The villages between the coast and Bridgwater keep journeys short, while Bridgwater itself has the most shops, takeaways and services. Bridgwater is the nearest large town to the site.

sections.heading: Towns crews stay in
sections.body_markdown:
We have houses in 3 towns and villages near the site:

| Town | Distance to site | Our houses | Bedrooms | From pppn |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cannington | 5.1 miles | 1 | 6 | £29.50 |
| Bridgwater | 7.2 miles | 1 | 5 | £32 |
| North Petherton | 9.6 miles | 1 | 4 | £35 |

Cannington is the closest and the Cannington house has van parking, which suits crews who start early. Bridgwater also has van parking and puts your team near the station and the M5. North Petherton sits just south of Bridgwater, handy if some of your crew also cover sites towards Taunton.

If you need more beds than these houses offer, tell us your numbers. We source additional houses near the site for crews on request, and we will be clear about what is and is not available before you book.

sections.heading: Planning accommodation for your crew size
sections.body_markdown:
Our houses near Hinkley Point C average 5 bedrooms each. As a rough guide:

- A crew of 6 needs about 2 houses.
- A crew of 12 needs about 3 houses.
- A crew of 24 needs about 5 houses.
- A crew of 50 needs about 10 houses.

Keeping each team together in its own house makes shift changes easier and cuts down on lift-sharing problems. Tell us which teams work together and we will group them.

sections.heading: Hotel vs whole house cost
sections.body_markdown:
Using a typical local hotel rate of £85 per person per night and our lowest nearby price of £29.50, a crew of 6 compares like this:

| Period | Hotel | Whole house | Saving |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 weeks (28 nights) | £14,280 | £4,956 | £9,324 (65%) |
| 12 weeks (84 nights) | £42,840 | £14,868 | £27,972 (65%) |

The hotel rate is typical for the area rather than a quote. The house price includes bills, Wi-Fi, council tax and cleaning, so there are no extras to add on top.

sections.heading: What's included
sections.body_markdown: Every house comes ready for a working crew, with bills, Wi-Fi, council tax and cleaning included. Each has a full kitchen so the crew can cook, a shared living room, and a washing machine for work gear. You pay one price per person per night, with nothing else to set up.

sections.heading: How booking works
sections.body_markdown: Send us your crew size, start date and expected length of stay, or call 0800 088 4225. We reply with a same-day quote showing the houses that fit, their distance to site and the price per person per night. You can book weekly or monthly and extend as the programme changes. Approved business accounts can pay on 14 to 30 day credit terms, and our UK team supports your crew 24/7 once they move in. StaysDirect is the direct operator, so there is no agency markup.
